full_prompt_en: A square, rough mixed-media cartoon painting shows a small white dog sitting against a vast, saturated yellow ground. The yellow fills the entire frame and carries scraped patches, dark speckles, faint color stains, and loose looping marks. There is no separate sky or room; a sketchy dark horizontal stroke near the lower edge is just enough to locate the figure on a surface. The dog sits in the lower half, with a large head stretching horizontally across the middle. Its white muzzle projects to the right and ends in a solid black oval nose. Two short black eye marks stand above a small, curved smile. A single black ear hangs at the left side of the head, making a strong dark patch against the pale fur. Several irregular black loops rise above the head, more like quick drawn gestures than carefully combed hair. The narrow neck leads to a compact seated body, with small front legs extending downward and two pale feet resting along the ground line. Black and gray rubbed strokes shape the body without producing smooth anatomical volume. Yellow paint flecks cross the white head and chest, tying the figure to the lively ground. The outer contour is uneven, reinforced in some places by repeated dark scribbles and allowed to break in others. Within the broad yellow field, fine black scratch marks, scattered red and blue dots, and darker rubbed areas keep the apparently simple background active. The image feels painted, scratched, and drawn over in successive passes rather than cleanly filled with flat color. Light is broadly even and graphic; there are no cast shadows or a modeled light source, while the white body gains prominence chiefly through value contrast with the warm ground. No letters or words are visible. The overall composition makes a spare central character feel buoyant through its playful asymmetry, coarse hand marks, and overwhelming bright yellow space.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、粗粝混合媒介卡通画：一只白色小狗坐在大片饱和黄色背景前。黄色铺满整个画框，其上有刮擦色块、深色斑点、浅淡色渍和松散的卷曲线条。画中没有另行区分的天空或房间；靠近下边缘的一道潦草深色横线刚好足以让人物落在某个表面上。小狗坐在下半部，宽大的头横向伸过画面中央。白色长口鼻朝右突出，以一个实心黑色椭圆鼻子收尾。两个短黑眼记号位于小小的弯曲微笑上方。一只黑耳朵垂在头的左侧，在浅色身体上构成有力的深色斑块。几道不规则黑线圈从头顶升起，更像迅速画出的动作痕迹，而非仔细梳理的毛发。细脖子连接紧凑的坐姿身体，短前腿向下伸，两只浅色脚沿地面线停放。揉擦的黑灰笔触塑造身体，却没有制造平滑的解剖体积。黄色颜料色屑穿过白色头部和胸口，把形体与活跃的背景连在一起。外轮廓不平整，有些地方由重复的深色涂划加强，另一些地方则出现断裂。宽阔黄色色场中，纤细黑色划痕、零星红蓝点和更深的擦抹区域，使看似简单的背景保持活跃。图像像经过多次涂绘、刮划和覆盖线稿，而不是由干净平涂填成。光线大致均匀、图形化；没有投影或可辨的塑形光源，白色身体主要凭借与暖色背景的明度对比突出。画中没有字母或词语。整体构图以俏皮的不对称、粗放手作笔痕和压倒性的亮黄色空间，让简练的中央形体显得轻盈跃动。
style_prompt_en: Expressive mixed-media cartoon painting puts loosely outlined pale shapes against large, saturated warm color fields. Black scribbles, repeated contour passes, scraped marks, and tiny scattered flecks keep the surface visibly handmade. The bright ground is not uniform: rubbed darker patches and occasional cool specks interrupt it without displacing its dominant hue. Simple rounded forms remain immediately legible even where edges are rough and partly broken. White areas contain traces of neighboring pigment, connecting foreground and background rather than keeping them pristine. Light is broadly even; contrast between pale, black, and intense warm areas creates emphasis without realistic cast shadows. The overall effect is exuberant, raw, and playful, with wide color space animated by restless small marks.
style_prompt_zh: 富于表现力的混合媒介卡通绘画把轮廓松散的浅色形体置于大片饱和暖色色域前。黑色涂划、重复勾边、刮擦笔痕和散落的小色屑让表面保留明显手作感。明亮底色并不均一：擦深的区域和偶尔出现的冷色点打断它，却不改变主导色相。即使边缘粗糙且局部断开，简单圆润的形体仍可立刻辨认。白色区域带有邻近颜料的痕迹，令前景与背景相连，而不是保持洁净。照明大致均匀；浅色、黑色和强烈暖色的对比在没有写实投影的情况下形成强调。整体效果热烈、粗放、俏皮，宽阔色彩空间由躁动的小笔迹激活。
theme_en: A scribbled white dog sitting on an intensely yellow painted ground
theme_zh: 涂划笔迹中的白色小狗坐在浓烈黄色画面前
name: Tom Everhart
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
